<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>古代美術文物展</title>
<script>
window.MathJax = {
  tex: {
    inlineMath: [['$', '$']],
    displayMath: [['$$', '$$']]
  }
};
</script>
<script defer src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3/es5/tex-mml-chtml.js"></script>
<style>
  * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    min-height: 100%;
    background: #d8d5c9;
  }

  body {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: flex-start;
    font-family: "Times New Roman", "Noto Serif CJK SC", "Songti SC", SimSun, serif;
  }

  .page {
    position: relative;
    width: 440px;
    height: 623px;
    overflow: hidden;
    color: #181713;
    background:
      repeating-linear-gradient(
        86deg,
        rgba(84, 75, 57, 0.018) 0,
        rgba(84, 75, 57, 0.018) 1px,
        transparent 1px,
        transparent 8px
      ),
      repeating-linear-gradient(
        2deg,
        rgba(87, 78, 61, 0.018) 0,
        rgba(87, 78, 61, 0.018) 1px,
        transparent 1px,
        transparent 11px
      ),
      linear-gradient(#deddd2 0%, #e7e5d9 61.8%, #e7e4d8 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, .22);
  }

  .faded-calligraphy {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0 0 auto 0;
    height: 207px;
    overflow: hidden;
    opacity: .085;
    color: #746d5d;
    font-family: "Noto Serif CJK SC", "Songti SC", SimSun, serif;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.8;
    letter-spacing: 5px;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .faded-calligraphy span {
    position: absolute;
    top: -5px;
    writing-mode: vertical-rl;
  }

  .faded-calligraphy .c1 { left: 4px; }
  .faded-calligraphy .c2 { left: 78px; }
  .faded-calligraphy .c3 { left: 137px; }
  .faded-calligraphy .c4 { left: 196px; }
  .faded-calligraphy .c5 { left: 271px; }
  .faded-calligraphy .c6 { left: 417px; }

  .left-title {
    position: absolute;
    top: 31px;
    left: 27px;
    z-index: 5;
    height: 145px;
    writing-mode: vertical-rl;
    text-orientation: upright;
    font-size: 17px;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
  }

  .museum {
    position: absolute;
    top: 31px;
    left: 56px;
    z-index: 5;
    height: 149px;
    writing-mode: vertical-rl;
    text-orientation: upright;
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
  }

  .address {
    position: absolute;
    top: 32px;
    left: 94px;
    z-index: 5;
    height: 101px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row-reverse;
    gap: 1px;
    font-family: "Noto Serif CJK SC", "Songti SC", SimSun, serif;
    font-size: 8px;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .address span {
    writing-mode: vertical-rl;
    text-orientation: upright;
    letter-spacing: 0;
  }

  .red-english {
    position: absolute;
    top: 47px;
    left: 253px;
    z-index: 7;
    height: 138px;
    color: #a9212d;
    writing-mode: vertical-rl;
    text-orientation: mixed;
    font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.16;
  }

  .large-character {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 8;
    font-family: "Noto Serif CJK TC", "Songti TC", "STSong", SimSun, serif;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: .88;
    color: #171612;
  }

  .char-gu {
    top: -14px;
    right: 21px;
    font-size: 116px;
  }

  .char-dai {
    top: 127px;
    right: 23px;
    font-size: 116px;
  }

  .char-mei {
    top: 373px;
    right: 23px;
    font-size: 112px;
  }

  .char-shu {
    top: 507px;
    right: 21px;
    font-size: 112px;
  }

  .landscape {
    position: absolute;
    top: 207px;
    left: 0;
    z-index: 2;
    width: 440px;
    height: 183px;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 0;
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 13% 91%, rgba(44, 55, 42, .95) 0 2%, transparent 2.5%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 23% 80%, rgba(48, 61, 45, .86) 0 6%, transparent 6.5%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 39% 82%, rgba(42, 62, 46, .78) 0 8%, transparent 8.5%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 48% 75%, rgba(45, 65, 48, .78) 0 8%, transparent 8.5%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 79% 60%, rgba(39, 55, 43, .82) 0 7%, transparent 7.5%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 91% 59%, rgba(36, 52, 40, .78) 0 8%, transparent 8.5%),
      linear-gradient(164deg, transparent 0 52%, rgba(191, 170, 131, .65) 52.5% 55%, transparent 55.5%),
      linear-gradient(180deg, #c4d0c8 0%, #c9d0c2 35%, #d9d2b7 68%, #d7ceb0 100%);
  }

  .landscape::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: -43px;
    bottom: -28px;
    width: 175px;
    height: 221px;
    transform: rotate(-11deg);
    border-radius: 46% 60% 21% 13%;
    background:
      repeating-radial-gradient(
        ellipse at 50% 48%,
        rgba(39, 35, 28, .78) 0 1px,
        transparent 1.5px 7px
      ),
      linear-gradient(125deg, #736a59, #c0b397 58%, #716b5c);
    box-shadow: inset -18px -9px 19px rgba(38, 37, 30, .34);
  }

  .landscape::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 229px;
    bottom: 25px;
    width: 92px;
    height: 42px;
    border-top: 2px solid rgba(103, 71, 44, .65);
    border-radius: 50%;
    transform: rotate(-12deg);
    box-shadow:
      0 -5px 0 -4px rgba(103, 71, 44, .65),
      0 -9px 0 -8px rgba(103, 71, 44, .55),
      0 -13px 0 -12px rgba(103, 71, 44, .45);
  }

  .tree {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 3;
    bottom: 22px;
    width: 2px;
    height: 71px;
    background: #353a31;
    transform-origin: bottom;
  }

  .tree::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: -11px;
    left: -12px;
    width: 26px;
    height: 27px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle, #303d32 0 22%, transparent 25%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 30% 55%, #354438 0 24%, transparent 27%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 70% 58%, #26382e 0 24%, transparent 27%);
  }

  .t1 { left: 316px; height: 62px; transform: rotate(5deg); }
  .t2 { left: 337px; height: 70px; transform: rotate(-4deg); }
  .t3 { left: 359px; height: 67px; transform: rotate(6deg); }
  .t4 { left: 382px; height: 69px; transform: rotate(-3deg); }
  .t5 { left: 405px; height: 73px; transform: rotate(4deg); }
  .t6 { left: 429px; height: 66px; transform: rotate(-6deg); }

  .painting-caption {
    position: absolute;
    left: 168px;
    top: 6px;
    color: transparent;
    font-size: 1px;
  }

  .seal {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 6;
    top: 14px;
